name: MyCoreRadLexAnatomy
title: MY Core Body Site (RadLex anatomy)
publisher: Data Team, Digital Health Division, Ministry of Health Malaysia
description: NATIONAL SELECTION. The anatomy of RadLex — the whole subtree below RadLex anatomical entity (RID3), 38,178 concepts. This is the body site vocabulary for radiology in MY Core, at any level of granularity from abdomen to a named muscle. Non-anatomical RadLex concepts such as findings, devices and imaging observations are out of scope, so a body site is always a body site. Concepts are enumerated rather than defined by filter, so the value set expands and validates without a RadLex-aware terminology server.
